title: Synthesis
description: The integrated final answer produced when the session ends with `verdict.next_action = finalize` and the runtime successfully completes the synthesis step (§2.6, §4.8, R2). A Synthesis is a specialized Message of `type = synthesis` — this file fixes the shape of the `content` payload, referenced from message.schema.json's per-type conditional.

synthesis_content.title: SynthesisContent
synthesis_content.description: The `content` payload of a synthesis Message. Carries the integrated answer plus the cumulative disagreement record collected across the session.

integrated_answer.description: The Coordinator's integrated final answer, addressing the original problem_statement. Free-form structured text.

resolved_disagreements.description: Cumulative list of disagreements the panel resolved across all rounds. Same shape as Verdict.resolved_disagreements.

unresolved_disagreements.description: Cumulative list of disagreements the panel did not reconcile. Same shape as Verdict.unresolved_disagreements. An empty array means the panel converged on every identified disagreement.

confidence.description: Coordinator's confidence in the synthesis, 0.0 to 1.0. Optional but RECOMMENDED.

open_questions.description: Questions the Coordinator surfaces as still open (not blocking the synthesis but worth tracking).
